entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Build failed with 3 errors #29565
  • The RealParent on Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Shapes.Rectangle has been Garbage Collected. This should never happen. #29563
  • Maui.Graphics GetStringSize Inverts Width and Height in version 9.0.70 (Windows only) #29562

Closed

  • Some of our users experience System.InvalidOperationException: Window was already deactivated on Windows #29494

    platform/android 🤖, community ✨, shell-search-handler

    platform/android 🤖, area-image, p/0, community ✨, t/perf, .NET 9 SR8
